paragraphs: Chapter 622
Episode 159. The Great Fight of the Two Kings (9)
With a thud!
Upon receiving a blow, blood welled up in his chest.
Jin had fought with all the Two Kings, except Boras.

Except for the battle with Teto, they were all messy fights. Starting with Kaio, Jin always ambushed his opponents after the fight was practically over. Even in cases where he defeated them head-on, like in the second fight with Teto, Nata, and Garmund, he only displayed a merciless swordsmanship, as if dealing with an archenemy.
He even swung his sword at the back of Linfa, who showed intentions to give up the fight.
Like the other Myungwang people said, if he hadn't gone crazy and tried to communicate, if he had asked them to simply acknowledge him as the successor...
If he had just asked them to support him as always... the brothers would have done so without hesitation.
'It's not enough.'

- So, brother, be more mindful and fight. Regardless of the outcome and process when the Two Kings tournament is over, the brothers will surely cherish Brother Jin as before... but never forget that the brothers are all humans. Even a little grudge, if left alone, festers over time.
A child favored by the absolute being always leaves a bitter grudge among the siblings.
Through the relationship between Rosa and Joshua, Jin learned this fact through time and experience.
Of course, the Myungwang clan is different from Runkandel, but in the end, they were humans.
Jin thought that all kinds of privileges and favoritism he received from the Myungwang clan could one day become a problem.
Today, Jin is going to burn away any threat of the future without leaving a trace.
Like Kaio's Two Kings technique, Baba's sword also resembled a divine instrument. Punishment had many similarities with Myungwang's domination sword.
Even when facing it, the real Myungwang's domination sword showed a much stronger momentum than its first chapter.
Jin was not suppressed by pressure as in Kaio's case. Even though Baba's energy exceeded him, he was swinging his sword as he wished.
Looking back, when the opening game was unfolded through the divine unity, the center of the Two Kings was Baba.
At that time, the rest of the Two Kings were supporting roles to help Baba attack properly. Kaio was in charge of the core of that support.

"Five of the divine instruments. If you hadn't learned that, if you hadn't shared the senses of the divine brothers through divine unity. You wouldn't have been able to mix your sword with me like now."
"Even if I received some benefits, how could it compare to being born a true Myungwang clan member? You're talking nonsense."
Those watching the fight were shocked.
It wasn't because of the conversation Jin and Baba had exchanged so far, or the intentions revealed through it.
The Myungwang clan was surprised that Jin was fighting on par with Baba.
Baba had expected such a situation since the first time she saw Jin in the temple today.
Yet, the outcome remains the same in his mind.
Sigmund and Light entangled fiercely. Aura and lightning were eroding everywhere, but as time passed, their battle approached the most essential form, 'sword fight'.
The loud and booming sound.
A huge rupture noise that was unbelievable considering it was just the clash of their swords, was resonating throughout the sky.
Because the weaving didn't stop for a single moment, it felt as if no sound could be heard.
The number of wounds on both bodies increased.
Surprisingly, the count was completely the same. Every time Jin cut, Baba also got cut. Even the locations perfectly mirrored each other.
An incredibly fierce battle continued.
Soon, both distanced themselves at the same time.
Jin expanded his space by unfolding the corrosion with the Myungwang domination sword, and Baba, in response, amplified her energy a step further.
Baba's power was a little stronger. The sign of the ultimate technique of the spiritual sword that Jin switched and unfolded made up for the difference.
"What are you going to do with a sword you haven't fully mastered, Jin Runkandel?"
Unlike with Kaio, the sign successfully blocked Baba's senses. It wasn't that Baba failed to block it and accepted the cut-off.
It didn't matter.
She closed her eyes before her senses were completely lost. Even in that state, she parried all of Jin's attacks just as before.
Rather, she became more fierce.
'To break through the ultimate technique of the spirit sword like this...'
The fact that she could demonstrate even more superior swordsmanship than before with her senses turned off.
If it was before experiencing the divine unity, it would have been a monstrous realm that Jin could hardly imagine.
Crack...!
A huge crack was spreading from the center of the main hall where the two were battling.
The main hall, which had withstood so many great fights without losing its robustness, was breaking apart.
Once the crack began, it absorbed the shock like a whirlpool, as the relationship between Jin and the Myungwang clan did.
It will collapse soon at this rate.
Jin decided to determine the match at that moment. Clearly, because Baba was stronger than him.
'I'll dive in the moment of falling.'
When the ground suddenly disappears, no matter if it's Jin and Baba, the center must be disturbed for a moment.
"I know what you're thinking."
"If you know, counterattack. You've already forgotten my advice."

There has never been a time in the history of the King of Fighters that the main hall collapsed. Also, the rules of the King of Fighters include ring-out defeats, and in this case, both would violate that rule.
Although it was an exceptional case, Ban did not stop the fight.
Their fight was no longer considered as the King of Fighters. It was closer to a fight between Jin and the Myungwang clan.
If it's Ban's power.
She could have prevented the hall from collapsing by spreading her energy and forcibly binding it, but she chose to let it break.

Even after losing the war with the gods, she did not prevent the main hall of the God of War, which had been moved intact to the dead world and was protecting the center of the old land of the Myungwang clan, now called the Mithra Desert, from breaking.
Crash...!
The moment the main hall split in half, each of the Myungwang people tightly closed their eyes.
They couldn't bear to watch the moment when the fight that started from a petty dispute shattered the heart of their homeland.
"Everyone, open your eyes and look straight ahead."
But they followed Ban's stern voice. The Myungwang clan all stared at the breaking hall and the two people entangled and fighting like demons inside.
As planned, Jin threw the decisive move when the hall was falling. As it fell, he stepped on the debris to narrow the distance between him and Baba.
The ultimate technique of the spiritual sword was already deactivated. Baba did not avoid and faced it head-on, and the two shared exactly the same damage again.
They both cut each other's left arm. The falling arms of the two were mixed somewhere in the debris of the falling main hall and disappeared.
And the moment they landed at the same time.
Jin and Baba were inevitably back-to-back as they cut each other and passed by.
Then the two turned around as if they had agreed and stabbed each other with their swords.
Crack, thud...!
The game was over.
Jin's sword stopped without reaching Baba's chest, and Baba's sword pierced Jin's spiritual armor and chest.
When Baba turned her sword once, Jin bent his waist and spit out a lump of blood.
It's not that Jin didn't 'stab' Baba. It's just that Baba's sword was faster than his.
"If you have something to say, say it now."
"Explode the energy..."
"What?"
"Like I did to Kaio."
"Do you think you can't?"
"Act on it. Your words about killing me."
Blood was flowing between Baba's clenched lips.
Jin tried to raise his right arm that held the sword, which had been lowered. His body, pierced by light, did not move as he wanted, but his sense was slowly returning.
Everyone was watching Jin trying to raise his arm and stab Baba again.
He was panting and convulsing like a wounded beast, but given time, he could muster enough strength to stab Baba.
"I just want to ask one thing, Jin. Why are you doing this? Why on earth?"
The conversations they had before crossing swords.
The discrimination and anxiety Jin said he felt, and the reasons why he crossed the line.
To Baba, and to the Myungwang clan. All these stories still could not justify this situation.
"I can't... explode it..."
"You can. You can explode it whenever you want. But, tell me once. Why did you drive the situation to this point?"
The Bradamante was slowly climbing towards Baba's neck.
It climbed to a point one inch away from the neck, fell due to force, then climbed again, getting closer.
Baba brothers, just end it quickly!
The Myungwang people, who had been so angry about what Jin had done so far.
Not a single person, no one, was shouting like that.
They just kept their trembling, bloodshot eyes fixed on the two.
"Please, please... talk. What you said earlier can't be everything, can it?"
"Are you just going to keep... making noise?"
Drip...!
Finally, the tip of the Bradamante touched Baba's neck. Despite barely touching it, the sharp blade penetrated Baba's neck skin too easily.
It only penetrated as much as the tip of a fingernail, but if Jin applies a little force now, Baba will meet death.
Still, Baba was unable to detonate the sword that had stabbed Jin's chest.
Through Jin's cloudy and dark eyes, to the blade on her neck, and back to Jin.
After leaving her gaze like that, Baba closed her eyes. Tears mixed with blood flowed between her closed eyelids.
"I understand, Brother Jin. As much as I can't comprehend it, if this is what you want. I will accept it."
Resolution.
She had made one resolution before heading into this battle.
Even if Jin did not stop until the very end, even if she ended up being killed by him.
She resolved never to let him go.
As a sibling, as his most precious family.

"But before you stab my neck... know one thing. Neither I nor our siblings have ever truly given up on you, no matter how astray you went. Even if everyone was angry and spewed hateful words, even if they said you were no longer a sibling, those were just words. They were just words spat out in anger."
Baba released the clenched fist holding the light.
Then, after reopening her eyes, she gripped the blade of the Bradamante with her right hand, looking at the wound she had inflicted on Jin.

"If you, Brother Jin, truly hated us, you would have made our hearts break when you stabbed Brother Kaio. You've stopped your sword even though you've regained the strength to stab me. But even if you move your sword again, I won't avoid it. If this is what you truly want, Brother Jin. But after I die, please come back. We're siblings..."
Even then, the watching Myungwang clan did not shout. No one told Baba to stop, or asked why it was Baba, not Jin, who was dying. There was no one even mentioning Lingling now.
They were people who would not abandon him, even if Jin ended up killing them all like this.
"You asked why I'm doing this, Brother Baba."
Brother. At that common title attached to her name, Baba lowered her hand holding the blade and touched Jin's face. The Bradamante fell to the floor.
"Yes, tell me, Brother Jin."
"Even though I'm doing all this... our siblings are just losing to me. So, that's why."
We should have fought once. At least once. We should have really fought.
Even if that meant hurting each other to this extent, they were certain they would never let go of each other in the end.
Finally confessing his villainy, Jin collapsed into Baba's arms.
All the siblings were rushing towards them.
